other_conditions: Total family annual income must be ≤ ₹2,50,000
Total family land holding must be wetland < 10 acres or dry land < 25 acres or combined wet + dry < 25 acres
No family member should be a government employee or government pensioner
Families of sanitary workers are exempted from eligibility criteria

Students must be admitted to recognized courses such as B.Tech, B.Pharmacy, ITI, Polytechnic, B.Ed, M.Tech, M.Pharmacy, MBA, or other degree/PG courses (PG courses only in government/university colleges)
Students must be enrolled in government, government‑aided, or private colleges affiliated with state universities/boards, including day‑scholar and hostel students
Applicant’s aggregate attendance must be at least 75%
No family member should own a four‑wheeler (taxi/tractor/auto are exempted)
Family should not own any property or own property less than 1500 sq ft of built‑up area in urban areas
No family member should be an income‑tax payee
benefits_summary: One‑time amount of ₹10,000 per year for five years (total ₹50,000) payable in installments for purchasing tools and equipment.
